title: Dry-Clean Pickup Delay
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:cleaning cleaner_name=* ready_epoch=* picked_up_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((picked_up_epoch-ready_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by cleaner_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures dry-clean pickup delay by cleaner for dry-cleaning pickups.
value: Lag tracking shows which cleaner create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside dry-cleaning pickups.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `dry-clean pickup delay` on `style:cleaning` events and aggregate them by `cleaner_name`.
visualization: Table of cleaner with average and worst dry-clean pickup delay.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how long things take for each cleaner so you can see where dry-cleaning pickups slows down.
